Primary request: a polished 3D conceptual scene of several abstract neural processors on a dark navy laboratory workbench, each connected to different test instruments representing accuracy, latency and cost. Cyan, violet and subtle amber lighting, clean sophisticated technical editorial aesthetic, wide landscape composition. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no fake charts or statistics. This is an illustration, not real analytics. Save generated output for project use.
